caption: A player hits a forehand drive, the ball spinning rapidly as it crosses the net.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Ball at baseline, net visible, no player or racket. Unknown: player’s position, racket motion, spin initiation, ball trajectory.

INTERACTION: Player’s swing (Clause 1) → ball contact → spin (Clause 3) and propulsion (Clause 2) initiated.

PERSISTENCE: Spin and low trajectory (Clauses 2–3) propagate ball’s motion across net; gravity and air resistance sustain deceleration and arc.

INTERVENTION: Absent player/racket → no contact → no spin or propulsion → ball remains stationary; if spin absent → trajectory less controlled; if force insufficient → ball fails to clear net.
